Both cells combined yield four nilpotent blocks at every odd length 1..2k-1 and a 14k² invertible sector. Fitting decomposition gives all cumulative transient counts and 15/16 at the final depth, including k=1. Independent direct GF(2) adjacency-power rank elimination verifies k=1,2,4 for all stages; the local-algebra proof, not extrapolation, establishes every a.
